fact: In a cohort of 140,308 patients with type 2 diabetes, treatment with tirzepatide was associated with significantly lower hazards of all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular and kidney events compared with GLP-1 RA.
fact_zh: 在一项包含140,308名2型糖尿病患者的队列研究中，与GLP-1 RA治疗相比，替西帕肽治疗与全因死亡率和主要不良心血管和肾脏事件的风险显著降低相关。
quote: In this cohort study of 140 308 patients with type 2 diabetes, treatment with tirzepatide was associated with significantly lower hazards of all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular and kidney events compared with GLP-1 RA.

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with lower all-cause mortality compared with GLP-1 RA (AHR, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.45-0.75; P < .001).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与较低的全因死亡率相关（调整后的风险比[AHR]，0.58；95%置信区间[CI]，0.45-0.75；P < 0.001）。
quote: We observed a lower hazard of all-cause mortality in patients given tirzepatide compared with GLP-1 RA (AHR, 0.58; 95% CI, 0.45-0.75; P < .001) (Table 2; Figure 2; Figure 3).

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with lower hazards of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACEs) compared with GLP-1 RA (AHR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71-0.91; P < .001).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与较低的主要不良心血管事件（MACEs）风险相关（AHR，0.80；95% CI，0.71-0.91；P < 0.001）。
quote: The hazard of MACEs was lower among patients treated with tirzepatide (AHR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71-0.91; P < .001), as was the hazard of kidney events (AHR, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.37-0.73; P < .001)...

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with lower hazards of major adverse kidney events (MAKEs) compared with GLP-1 RA (AHR, 0.54; 95% CI, 0.44-0.67; P < .001).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与较低的主要不良肾脏事件（MAKEs）风险相关（AHR，0.54；95% CI，0.44-0.67；P < 0.001）。
quote: The hazard of MACEs was lower among patients treated with tirzepatide (AHR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71-0.91; P < .001), as was the hazard of kidney events (AHR, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.37-0.73; P < .001)...

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with lower hazards of acute kidney injury (AKI) compared with GLP-1 RA (AHR, 0.78; 95% CI, 0.70-0.88; P < .001).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与较低的急性肾损伤（AKI）风险相关（AHR，0.78；95% CI，0.70-0.88；P < 0.001）。
quote: The hazard of MACEs was lower among patients treated with tirzepatide (AHR, 0.80; 95% CI, 0.71-0.91; P < .001), as was the hazard of kidney events (AHR, 0.52; 95% CI, 0.37-0.73; P < .001), AKI (AHR, 0.78; 95% CI, 0.70-0.88; P < .001)...

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with greater reductions in HbA1c compared with GLP-1 RA (treatment difference, −0.34 percentage points; 95% CI, −0.44 to −0.24 percentage points).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与更大的HbA1c降低相关（治疗差异，−0.34个百分点；95% CI，−0.44至−0.24个百分点）。
quote: Compared with GLP-1 RA treatment, tirzepatide treatment was associated with greater reductions in HbA 1c (treatment difference, −0.34 percentage points; 95% CI, −0.44 to −0.24 percentage points)...

fact: Tirzepatide was associated with greater reductions in body weight compared with GLP-1 RA (treatment difference, −2.9 kg; 95% CI, −4.8 to −1.1 kg).
fact_zh: 与GLP-1 RA相比，替西帕肽与更大的体重减少相关（治疗差异，−2.9 kg；95% CI，−4.8至−1.1 kg）。
quote: Compared with GLP-1 RA treatment, tirzepatide treatment was associated with greater reductions in HbA 1c (treatment difference, −0.34 percentage points; 95% CI, −0.44 to −0.24 percentage points) and body weight (treatment difference, −2.9 kg; 95% CI, −4.8 to −1.1 kg)...

fact: The study included 14,834 patients treated with tirzepatide and 125,474 patients treated with GLP-1 RA.
fact_zh: 该研究包括14,834名接受替西帕肽治疗的患者和125,474名接受GLP-1 RA治疗的患者。
quote: Within the cohort of patients with type 2 diabetes, 14 834 received tirzepatide, while 125 474 were prescribed a GLP-1 RA during the study time frame (Figure 1).

fact: After propensity score matching, each group included 14,832 individuals for outcome analyses.
fact_zh: 倾向评分匹配后，每个组包括14,832名个体用于结果分析。
quote: Following PSM, each group included 14 832 individuals for our outcome analyses (Table 1).

fact: Before propensity score matching, tirzepatide-treated patients were younger (mean [SD] age, 55.4 [11.8] years) compared with the GLP-1 RA group (mean [SD] age, 58.1 [13.3] years) (P < .001).
fact_zh: 倾向评分匹配前，接受替西帕肽治疗的患者年龄较小（平均[SD]年龄，55.4 [11.8]岁），与GLP-1 RA组（平均[SD]年龄，58.1 [13.3]岁）相比（P < 0.001）。
quote: Before PSM, tirzepatide-treated patients were younger (mean [SD] age, 55.4 [11.8] years) compared with the GLP-1 RA group (mean [SD] age, 58.1 [13.3] years) (P < .001).

fact: After propensity score matching, the two groups were balanced, with standardized differences for all the included covariates being less than 0.1.
fact_zh: 倾向评分匹配后，两组之间平衡，所有纳入协变量的标准差异均小于0.1。
quote: After PSM, the 2 groups were balanced, with standardized differences for all the included covariates being less than 0.1 (Table 1).

fact: The study used data from the TriNetX database, which collects deidentified, patient-level data from electronic health records.
fact_zh: 该研究使用了TriNetX数据库的数据，该数据库从电子健康记录中收集匿名的患者级数据。
quote: This cohort study used data from the TriNetX database, which collects deidentified, patient-level data from electronic health records.

fact: The study was conducted adhering to the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki and the STROBE reporting guideline.
fact_zh: 该研究遵循《赫尔辛基宣言》的原则和STROBE报告指南进行。
quote: This study was conducted adhering to the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki 15 and adhered to the Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE) reporting guideline.

fact: The study excluded patients with acute myocardial infarction, intracranial hemorrhage, or cerebral infarction within 60 days before the index prescription date.
fact_zh: 该研究排除了在索引处方日期前60天内发生急性心肌梗死、颅内出血或脑梗死的患者。
quote: Individuals with acute myocardial infarction, intracranial hemorrhage, or cerebral infarction within 60 days before the index prescription date were excluded to avoid misidentifying incident outcomes.

fact: The study excluded patients with stage 5 chronic kidney disease (CKD), end-stage kidney disease (ESKD), or receiving dialysis at baseline from the major adverse kidney event (MAKE) outcome analysis.
fact_zh: 该研究从主要不良肾脏事件（MAKE）结果分析中排除了基线时患有5期慢性肾病（CKD）、终末期肾病（ESKD）或正在接受透析的患者。
quote: To mitigate misinterpretation, individuals with stage 5 chronic kidney disease (CKD), with end-stage kidney disease (ESKD), or receiving dialysis at baseline were excluded from the major adverse kidney event (MAKE) outcome analysis.

fact: The study conducted 1:1 propensity score matching involving 48 variables covering demographics, comorbidities, medications, and laboratory results.
fact_zh: 该研究进行了涉及48个变量的1:1倾向评分匹配，涵盖人口统计学、合并症、药物和实验室结果。
quote: We conducted 1:1 propensity score matching (PSM) that involved 48 variables covering demographics, comorbidities, medications, and laboratory results.

fact: The study adjusted for covariates including age, sex, race and ethnicity, cardiovascular disease, diabetes complications, and medications such as diuretics, lipid-lowering agents, and hypoglycemic agents.
fact_zh: 该研究调整了包括年龄、性别、种族和民族、心血管疾病、糖尿病并发症以及利尿剂、降脂药和降糖药等药物在内的协变量。
quote: We considered the following variables to adjust for imbalances in baseline characteristics between the tirzepatide and GLP-1 RA groups: age; sex; race and ethnicity (as documented in the electronic health record); cardiovascular disease; dementia; chronic lower-respiratory disease; autoimmune disease; CKD; chronic hepatitis; liver cirrhosis; anemia; HIV; neoplasms; socioeconomic status and psychosocial-related health hazards; diabetic complications; and medicines including diuretics, lipid-lowering agents, hypoglycemic agents, and hypotensive agents.

fact: The study evaluated the composite of all-cause mortality and major adverse cardiovascular events (MACEs) as a secondary outcome.
fact_zh: 该研究将全因死亡率和主要不良心血管事件（MACEs）的复合指标作为次要结果进行评估。
quote: Additionally, we investigated acute kidney injury (AKI) and the composite of all-cause mortality and MACEs.
